Commentary.Commentary: There is still something in this wicket and the chase is going to be really interesting!
We are back for the chase! Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan walk out to the middle. Reece Topley has the new ball in his hand will start proceedings.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

India on the other hand have shown why their bowling attack is so highly rated. They were on the money and extracted the most off the pitch. The opening bowlers were on fire and were really unlucky to not pick more wickets. Overall they conceded a few runs through short balls but bowled to a plan and kept regularly picking at the English wickets. Yuzvendra Chahal was the pick of the bowlers as he ended up taking 4 wickets while conceding only 47 runs in his full quota of 10 overs. Hardik Pandya and Jasprit Bumrah contributed with 2 wickets each and overall all the bowlers performed wonderfully to bowl out their opponents. Their batters do have an opportunity here to secure the series. Can they do so? Or will England pull off something special? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay!

The English openers started tentatively but managed to negotiate the new ball and preserve their wickets with a little bit of luck. However, both gave away their wickets after getting off to a decent start and the batters that followed kept up with the aggressive approach but did not last long. Eventually, England found themselves reeling at 102 for the loss of 5 wickets. Liam Livingstone played a cameo and perished in a short-ball hitting competition against Hardik Pandya. It was the partnership between Moeen Ali and David Willey of 62 runs that pushed the total beyond the 200 mark. Both of them though fell short of their half centuries and now they will have to come out with some intent with the ball if they have to win this game.

Rohit Sharma will be absolutely thrilled with the performance of his bowlers after winning the toss. The pitch was not as helpful as the one we saw at The Oval and despite that, they have managed to bowl out and restrict this strong English batting lineup to a total of 246. They would be silently confident of achieving this target and sealing the series.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! A classical Jasprit Bumrah dismissal! He finishes the innings off with a lovely delivery! A pacey, yorker-length delivery, on target this time, on the off pole. Reece Topley makes room, clears his front foot and tries to slash this away but he misses. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. England are bundled out for 246!
Short this time, around middle. Craig Overton pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.

Third yorker in the over! Around middle. Reece Topley knocks it towards mid on and scampers across to the other end. Virat Kohli there scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Reece Topley is well in!
Another one in the blockhole! This is just away from the off pole. Reece Topley once again fails to squeeze it out.
Nothing off the Free Hit! A yorker, outside off. Reece Topley fails to dig this one out.

No ball! A length ball, around middle and off. Reece Topley swings his bat at it but he fails to get any connection on that! Jasprit Bumrah has overstepped here and a no ball is called! Free Hit is coming up!
A dipping full toss, around middle and off. Craig Overton knocks it towards long on and takes a single.
Full and outside off. Reece Topley makes room and looks to hoick this one but he misses.
Full and outside off. Reece Topley pushes it towards point for a brace.

OUT! LBW! Prasidh Krishna gets hit first wicket of the game as well and England are now 9 down! Initially, it looked like he got some bat on it, but there was a muted appeal from Prasidh Krishna there for LBW and the umpire did agree to that one! A length ball, around middle. Brydon Carse swivels and tries to pull this one but he misses and gets hit near his groin area. He departs after the umpire raises his finger!

Fullish ball, outside off. Brydon Carse finally gets some bat onto the ball. He hits it towards point. They take a single. The fielder throws it towards the stumps at the non-striker's but he misses. The batters sneak in another run as well.
Wide! Wide of off, yorker-length delivery. Brydon Carse leaves it alone. Wide called!
Slower one, on a length. Brydon Carse looks to heave this but he misses again.
A yorker-length delivery, outside off. Brydon Carse fails to dig this one out.

OUT! CAUGHT! India have finally got rid of David Willey! But he has played a vital knock here for England! Jasprit Bumrah gets his first wicket of the game. He serves it on a length, slower in pace, around middle. David Willey looks to heave this but he gets undone by the lack of pace and ends up lobbing up towards long on. Shreyas Iyer (sub) catches it after he juggles it once.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shreyas Iyer b Jasprit Bumrah

Commentary.Commentary: Another slower one, on a length, outside off. Craig Overton pushes it towards point for a single.
Very full this time, around middle. David Willey knocks it towards long off for a single.
Slower one this time, full and outside off. David Willey taps it towards point.

CLOSE CALL! On a length, around middle. David Willey heaves it towards long on. They take the first one run fast and leave the crease for the second run as well. Shreyas Iyer (sub) there collects the ball on a bounce and throws it towards Jasprit Bumrah, who fails to grab the ball. Two taken!
SIX! BANG! These are important runs for England! Jasprit Bumrah hits the deck hard and serves a short ball, around middle. David Willey pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Two Leg byes! A yorker-length delivery, down the leg side. Craig Overton tries to squeeze this one away, but the ball goes off his pads and towards fine leg. The batters sneak in two leg byes!
Tad slower now, at 124 clicks, on a length, and on the pads. David Willey tucks it in the vacant mid-wicket region. Hardik Pandya runs there and cuts it out. Single taken!
Slightly short again, around off. Craig Overton pulls it firmly but finds Shikhar Dhawan at deep mid-wicket. Only a single!
Well bowled once again! Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Craig Overton pushes it back to Hardik Pandya.
Swing and a miss! Fraction shorter on this occasion, outside off, at 135 clicks. Craig Overton stays in his crease and tries to pull this but he misses.
Shorter ball, around middle. David Willey swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Hardik Pandya is back on!

Mohammad Shami is nailing in these yorkers, as this one is also delivered on middle, Craig Overton inside edges this towards deep backward square leg and scampers across for a couple of well-taken runs!
Just short of being a yorker and in line with the stumps, Craig Overton jams his bat down and digs the ball back to the bowler. Change of tactics from short to bowling full!
Low full toss outside off punched down the ground past the bowler. Yuzvendra Chahal at long off does well to save the boundary and restrict the batters to two runs.
Mohammad Shami serves this full once again outside off, David Willey looking to be aggressive but gets an inside edge once again to fine leg for a single.
This is a slow yorker in line with the stumps, David Willey fends this back to the bowler.
Mohammad Shami goes full from 'round the wicket into the stumps, David Willey takes a heave at it and gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a brace.
Loopy one now, fuller ball. Craig Overton clips it towards mid-wicket. End of an excellent spell from Yuzvendra Chahal. He ends with the figures of 10-0-47-4!
A googly this time, outside off, fuller ball. Craig Overton cuts it towards point.
Quicker, flatter, on the pads. David Willey flicks it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery, outside off, full in length. Craig Overton sweeps it towards deep square leg. Shikhar Dhawan cuts it out. Single taken!
Tosses it up, pitched up as well, around off. Craig Overton lunges forward and defends it out.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Craig Overton leans and blocks it out solidly.

Yorker right at the toes! David Willey just about manages to bring his bat down in time to dig the ball out. Gets it to bump into the pitch and lob over the bowler to break the stumps for the third time in this innings.
Full once again in line with the stumps, David Willey defends this back towards Mohammad Shami who collects at throws it back towards the keeper.
Mohammad Shami bowls a low full toss on middle and off, Craig Overton works this toward mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Craig Overton defends this solidly to the cover fielder.
Back of a length outside off, Craig Overton dabs this towards backward point.
WIDE! Mohammad Shami goes short this time into the batter. Craig Overton ducks awkwardly and the umpire calls wide for height.
Mohammad Shami goes 'round the wicket and angles this on from outside off. David Willey punches this towards long on for a single.
Craig Overton is the new batter at the wicket. Mohammad Shami (8-0-38-1) has been brought back into the attack.

OUT! TAKEN! The 62-run stand for England has finally been broken and it's none other than Yuzvendra Chahal who has provided India with the breakthrough! He tosses it up, full, around middle. Moeen Ali gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. The ball goes off the toe end and flies towards Ravindra Jadeja there, who pouches it safely. He does not drop many. Yuzvendra Chahal has grabbed his fourth wicket as Moeen Ali departs after a solid knock of 47.
Commentary.Howout: c Ravindra Jadeja b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Leg bye! Quicker one, on the pads. David Willey stays in his crease and tries to flick it but he misses. The ball goes towards fine leg off his pads. Leg bye taken!
Full, around middle and leg. David Willey flicks it but that's straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller one, at 86 clicks, on the pads. David Willey looks to flick this but he gets a leading edge towards point.
Tosses it up again, down the leg side. Moeen Ali backs away and works it away towards square leg for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and leg. Moeen Ali flicks and finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Jasprit Bumrah bangs this one short as well outside off, David Willey looks to pull this and gets an inside edge down onto the pitch as it rolls into the leg side.
Short delivery outside off, Moeen Ali cuts this to deep point for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah delivers this a touch fuller and outside off, Moeen Ali hits this hard but finds the mid off fielder.
Jasprit Bumrah serves this on a good length outside off. Moeen Ali guides this to the point fielder.
Serves a slower short ball outside off, Moeen Ali leaves this one alone.

SIX! BOOM! Moeen Ali has put his foot on the pedal! Length ball on a middle stump line, sits up nicely for Moeen Ali to pull this over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit! Caught by a member of the crowd but that won't count as Moeen Ali adds six to his tally!
Powerplay 3! An extra fielder can be placed at the boundary for the last 10 overs.
A full toss, around middle. Moeen Ali drives it on the up towards cover. Single taken!
Fuller now, outside off. Moeen Ali taps it towards point.

DROPPED! A top effort though! That was not an easy chance! Shorter one, around middle. David Willey looks to pull but he gets a top edge towards mid on. Hardik Pandya dives to his left, and stretches his left hand out but he manages to get only his fingertips on it. Single taken!
FOUR! Edgy runs! Length, outside off. David Willey leans to drive but the ball goes off his outside edge towards third man for a boundary. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
Leg bye! On a length, on the pads. Moeen Ali looks to flick this one but he misses. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
Swing and a miss! On a length from 'round the wicket, outside off. Moeen Ali throws his bat at it but he fails to get any connection on that one.
Mohammad Shami (7-0-32-1) is back on!
Jasprit Bumrah continues bowling on a good length outside off, David Willey guides this towards point.
On a good length this time outside off, David Willey hits this towards mid off.

FOUR! Short ball concedes another boundary! Albeit a top edge! Jasprit Bumrah hits the pitch hard on a shorter length and aims for the body. David Willey swings his bat and gets a top edge towards the fine leg boundary for four more runs!
Jasprit Bumrah goes full and on middle, takes some pace off the ball. David Willey knocks this towards cover.
Jasprit Bumrah serves this straight and on a good length, David Willey defends this to the left of the bowler.
On a good length outside off. Moeen Ali guides this to deep cover-point for a single.
Tad shorter, darting it on the pads now. David Willey hangs back and nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Change of angle now! Yuzvendra Chahal goes 'round the wicket, serves a fuller ball, outside off. David Willey leans to block this one but the ball goes off his inner half and towards square leg.
A googly, shorter one, outside off. David Willey uses the depth of the crease and blocks it out.
Loopy ball, very full, around middle. Moeen Ali knocks it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Tosses it up, full, around middle, a leg-break. Moeen Ali gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Tad quicker, full, and on the pads. Moeen Ali works it away towards mid-wicket.

SIX! Second maximum of the over and this time from the bat of David Willey! Prasidh Krishna goes short once again and angling down leg. David Willey pulls and helps the ball on its way over the third-man fence for six more runs! The short ball may have picked up wickets but is conceding a lot of runs! 15 runs of the over from Prasidh Krishna!
Goes full outside off, Moeen Ali swings and gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Prasidh Krishna bangs this in short and angles it into the batter. David Willey works this away awkwardly towards square leg for a single.
Prasidh Krishna goes full outside off, Moeen Ali guides this to deep point for a single.

SIX! What a shot! Prasidh Krishna angles this into the pads from a good length. Moeen Ali is in the perfect position to pick it up off his legs over the deep backward square leg boundary for a biggie! Moeen Ali is playing a wonderful inning here!
Prasidh Krishna serves this one on a good length outside off, Moeen Ali fends this towards backward point.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. David Willey blocks it out.
A leg-break, on the pads, shortish ball. David Willey flicks it towards square leg.
Fuller now, slower through the air, around middle. David Willey presses forward and blocks it out.
Touch shorter, spinning in, around middle and leg. Moeen Ali works it away towards square leg for a single.
Tosses it up again, tad shorter, around middle. Moeen Ali pulls this one and finds the fielder at square leg.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. David Willey knocks it down to long on for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes back into the attack. He replaces Ravindra Jadeja.
Serves this one full on off, Moeen Ali punches this back down the wicket and the stumps do the fielding once again.
Prasidh Krishna angles this into the pads from a good length. David Willey clips this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
On a good length and angling into the stumps from outside off. David Willey fends this to the right of the bowler.
Prasidh Krishna goes 'round the wicket now and serves this on a good length outside off. Moeen Ali works this to deep backward point for a single.
Good-length delivery this time outside off, Moeen Ali taps this towards the wide slip fielder.

FOUR! This has been pulled handsomely for a boundary! Prasidh Krishna begins with a short ball in line with the stumps, Moeen Ali gets on top of the bounce and pulls it hard towards the mid-wicket boundary for four runs!
Another short ball, outside off. David Willey pushes it towards Ravindra Jadeja off the back foot.
Shorter one, outside off. Moeen Ali uses the depth of the crease and punches it down to long off for a run.
Fuller this time, outside off. Moeen Ali presses forward and blocks it out solidly.
Quick again, at 95 clicks, on the pads. Moeen Ali steps down the pitch and tries to flick this one but he misses and the ball lobs up off his pads.
Quicker one, shorter as well, on middle. Moeen Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller on this occasion, fires it on the pads. David Willey flicks it past square leg for a single.
Pulls his length back once again, and delivers this outside off. Moeen Ali strides forward and defends it solidly towards cover.
Prasidh Krishna goes full outside off, David Willey hits this well through covers for a single.
Good length once again, outside off. David Willey taps this towards the cover fielder.
Prasidh Krishna serves this on a good length outside off. Moeen Ali works this through the right of cover for a single.
Good-length delivery outside off. Moeen Ali defends this towards cover-point.
Prasidh Krishna bowls a well-directed bouncer to begin. David Willey fends this awkwardly towards backward square leg for a single.
Prasidh Krishna has been brought back into the attack.
Turning in, shorter ball, on the pads. David Willey works it away towards square leg for a single.
Fuller now, around middle. David Willey blocks it out.
Outside off, tad shorter. Moeen Ali cuts it towards point for a single.
Shorter one, around middle. Moeen Ali looks to flick this one but he gets a leading edge towards short third man. No run there!
Spinning in, short again. Moeen Ali shows the full face of the bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, quick one, outside off. David Willey knocks it off the back foot towards long off for a single.
Hardik Pandya serves this on a good length outside off, Moeen Ali guides this towards backward point.

DROPPED! A chance goes begging for India! Hardik Pandya bangs this short in line with he stumps, David Willey goes for the pull and top edges it high towards third man. Prasidh Krishna positions himself under the ball and goes down to his knees while trying to catch it. Spills the ball in the process and David Willey gets a lifeline! India will be very disappointed as they give their catching huge importance! England will be hoping to make them pay!
A fraction short outside off, David Willey mistimes this straight back past the bowler onto the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Straight ball on a good length. David Willey fends this to the left of the bowler.
On a good length outside off, Moeen Ali punches this towards point and a misfield by the fielder allows them to take a single.
No run. On a length, outside off. Moeen Ali pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Drifting it in, around middle and leg. Moeen Ali works it away towards square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Touch slower, full, and on the pads. David Willey tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Around middle and leg, shorter one. David Willey defends it off the back foot.
Full again, around middle. Moeen Ali strokes it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Another pitched-up delivery, around middle. Moeen Ali knocks towards mid-wicket.
Fuller one, quick as well, around middle. Moeen Ali lunges forward and blocks it out.
DRINKS! A lot has changed since the last Drinks break! It's India who are on top at the moment. They have grabbed 6 wickets and have put England under the pump.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hardik Pandya may have been losing the battle but he definitely wins the war! The short ball ploy works and Liam Livingstone eventually holes out in the deep! Hardik Pandya persists with the short ball outside off, Liam Livingstone goes for the pull but does not get a hold of it. Shreyas Iyer at deep suqare leg is perfectly in place to pouch this and India celebrate the demise of Liam Livingstone's innings!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shreyas Iyer b Hardik Pandya

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Liam Livingstone is winning this battle against Hardik Pandya! This one is also served short outside off, Liam Livingstone drags it towards mid-wicket as it flies to the fence for a boundary! This is proving to be an expensive over!

SIX! This one has been dispatched! Liam Livingstone comes down the wicket and Hardik Pandya bangs this one short in response. Liam Livingstone swings his bat at this and gets enough bat on it to atke it over the backward square leg boundary for a maximum!
Hardik Pandya goes full and angles it into the stumps. Liam Livingstone chips this into the air and the ball floats over the mid on fielder and the batters complete a couple of runs.
WIDE! Down the leg side now from back of a length. Liam Livingstone leaves it alone and the umpire calls this wide down leg.
WIDE! Hardik Pandya bangs this on into the pitch in line with the stumps. Liam Livingstone ducks under this and the square leg umpire indicates it is wide.
Slightly short and pitching on leg, Moeen Ali pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Hardik Pandya continues bowling on a good length outside off, Moeen Ali works this towards point.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, some turn for Jadeja again, outside off. Liam Livingstone pushes it off the back foot towards cover. Tidy over from Ravindra Jadeja!
Shorter ball, spinning away a tad, outside off. Liam Livingstone taps it towards cover-point.
Full, quick, around middle. Moeen Ali works it away towards mid on and takes a single.
Tad shorter, around middle and off. Moeen Ali pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller this time, quick, around off. Liam Livingstone drives it powerfully onto the ground and it goes towards Rohit Sharma at cover. He stretches and makes a half-stop there! Single taken!
Shorter one, quicker as well, flatter ball. Liam Livingstone punches it towards deep cover for a brace.
Short once again outside off, Liam Livingstone is down the track and mistimes his pull towards deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Hardik Pandya bangs this one in short outside off, Liam Livingstone ducks down suddenly and the umpire calls it wide on height.
This one is on the pads from a good length. Moeen Ali clips this towards square leg for a single.
Delivers this on a good length outside off, Moeen Ali defends this towards the cover fielder.
Hardik Pandya bowling good length here outside off, Moeen Ali looks to cut but the ball is too close to the body. Gets an inside edge onto his body and the ball falls into the pitch.
Good-length delivery once again outside off, Moeen Ali guides this towards cover-point.
Hardik Pandya serves this on a good length and angling away from middle. Moeen Ali fends this towards short cover.
Hardik Pandya (2-0-5-1) comes back into the attack.
Tad shorter now, around middle and leg. Moeen Ali works it away towards square leg and takes a run. He retains the strike!
Back to over the wicket, full, quicker around middle. Moeen Ali flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Goes 'round the wicket to the right-hander, serves a fuller one, around off. Liam Livingstone knocks it down to long off and takes a single.
Full again, around middle, tad slower. Moeen Ali works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, fuller again. Moeen Ali pushes it through cover. Shikhar Dhawan chases the ball and does well to keep the ball away from the ropes. Two taken!
Ravindra Jadeja begins with a fuller one, quicker from 'round the wicket, around middle. Moeen Ali taps it towards mid-wicket.
Ravindra Jadeja is introduced into the attack.
Angles this one down leg and on a good length. Liam Livingstone looks to work this leg side but misses. The umpire does not call wide as the ball might have clipped the legs.
Jasprit Bumrah bangs this one in short and in line with the stumps. Liam Livingstone ducks under this and leaves it alone.
Straight and on a good length. Liam Livingstone defends this towards mid on.

FOUR! Great timing from Liam Livingstone! Jasprit Bumrah goes full on off, Liam Livingstone drives this straight back to the right of the stumps. Mid on has no chance as this runs to the straight boundary for four runs!
This one is angled into the pads on a good length. Moeen Ali hits this with soft hands towards mid-wicket and runs across for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah comes 'round the wicket and angles this in from a good length. Moeen Ali defends this back to the bowler's left.
Slower through the air, full, another leg-break, outside off. Liam Livingstone blocks it out off the front foot.
Shorter ball, darting it on the pads. Moeen Ali flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Wide! Tad shorter, spinning down the leg side. Moeen Ali leaves it alone. Wide called!
Tad quicker, full, around middle. Liam Livingstone lunges forward and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Pitches it up again, around off. Moeen Ali presses forward and taps it towards cover. Single taken!
Outside off, fuller one, spinning away. Liam Livingstone drives it towards cover and rotates the strike.
SIX! KABOOM! Tosses it up, full, around off. Liam Livingstone dances down the pitch and tonks it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Straight delivery on a good length. Liam Livingstone taps this towards square leg and rushes across for a quick single.
Jasprit Bumrah delivers this full in line with the stumps, Liam Livingstone knocks this firmly towards mid off.
Bangs this one in short and aimed for the body. Liam Livingstone ducks under this one.
This one is on a good length outside off, Liam Livingstone defends this towards cover.
Jasprit Bumrah pulls his length back a fraction outside off, Liam Livingstone gets on top of the bounce and fends it awkwardly towards cover-point.
Jasprit Bumrah begins with a good-length delivery from around the wicket and pitching outside off, Moeen Ali clips this through square leg for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah (4-1-16-0) comes back into the attack.
Slower through the air, a leg-break, outside off. Liam Livingstone drives it towards cover. Another over and it's another successful one from Yuzvendra Chahal!
Another one on the pads, full in length. Moeen Ali works it away to square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Full again, on the pads this time. Moeen Ali blocks it out.
Moeen Ali is the new batter in. He has a lot of work to do here.

OUT! LBW! Yuzvendra Chahal has taken his third wicket as he sends Ben Stokes packing! England have lost half their side now. They are in a spot of bother. Yuzvendra Chahal tosses this one up, full, and it lands around off and spins in. Ben Stokes gets down and goes for the reverse-sweep again, but he misses this time and gets hit on his pads. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Ben Stokes goes up for review. No spike on UltraEdge and Ball Tracking shows three reds. Ben Stokes has to walk back! England have no reviews left now!
Slower through the air this time, loopy ball, full and on the pads. Ben Stokes advances down the pitch and misses his flick.
Tosses this one up, full, spinning away a tad. Liam Livingstone drives it through cover for a single.
This one is served full outside off. Ben Stokes hits this hard towards the mid off fielder. Just 2 runs of the over! A good one from Mohammad Shami!
Mohammad Shami goes for a yorker on the pads, Liam Livingstone gets his bat down in time and flicks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Mohammad Shami goes a fraction fuller on off. Liam Livingstone defends this back to the bowler.
WIDE! This one is banged in short and on middle. Liam Livingstone attempts to pull this but is too high. The umpire calls wide for height.
Mohammad Shami goes full in line of the stumps. Liam Livingstone knocks this towards mid on.
Mohammad Shami looking in good rhythm. The is delivered on a good length outside off, Liam Livingstone taps this towards cover.
Mohammad Shami serves this on a good length outside off. There is some extra bounce as Liam Livingstone smothers this towards the off side.
Tosses it up, full and outside off. Liam Livingstone drives it towards long off for a single. He retains the strike!
Full, loopy ball, around the leg pole. Ben Stokes makes room and knocks it towards long on for a single.
And again! A fuller one, outside off this time. Ben Stokes misses his reverse-sweep this time.
FOUR! This is clever batting! He is playing to the field! Quicker, a low full toss, around middle. Ben Stokes gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it past point for another boundary.
Ben Stokes goes for the reverse-sweep to a fuller ball again! Not in the gap though it goes towards deep cover. Two taken!
FOUR! Wow! Lovely shot from Ben Stokes! Full, around middle and leg. Ben Stokes gets low and rever-sweeps this one past cover-point for a boundary. Perfectly executed!
Liam Livingstone comes down the wicket in response. Mohammad Shami serves this short and wide from the stumps. Liam Livingstone decides to leave this alone.
Slight halt in play! Liam Livingstone has been struck on his helmet. The physio is out there to conduct the mandatory concussion test.

Mohammad Shami welcomes Liam Livingstone with a bouncer straight on the helmet! This one is banged in short and aimed to do damage! Liam Livingstone tries to duck and reacts really late. Gets thumped on the head and the umpire calls for the physio! This was bowled at 139 clicks and Mohammad Shami is bowling with some fire!
Liam Livingstone makes him way out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Mohammad Shami totally deserves this wicket! He has bowled wonderfully today and reaps the benefits with the big wicket of the England skipper! Mohammad Shami goes full and attacks the stumps, Jos Buttler plays all over this and gets castled! He tries to flick this one but he misses it completely. Four down now and England will need to rebuild here!
Mohammad Shami goes full outside off, Jos Buttler comes across the stumps and knocks this towards mid off.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Jos Buttler plays this to the left of point for a coupe of runs.
Slightly fuller, around middle and leg. Ben Stokes clips it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Full delivery outside off, Jos Buttler places this in the gap at covers and completes a brace.
Yuzvendra Chahal serves this full on off, Jos Buttler uses his wrists and works this towards mid-wicket.
Jos Buttler the skipper of England walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Yuzvendra Chahal gets another one! Two wickets in two overs for him! Yuzvendra Chahal serves this full and dead straight. Joe Root goes to sweep and plays over the ball. The ball hits him low on the pads and Yuzvendra Chahal jumps up and appeals! The umpire raises his finger! Joe Root opts for a review! Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates three reds! England loses Joe Root and they lose a review as well.
Full once again and in line with the stumps. Joe Root defends this towards mid-wicket.
Full and spinning in from middle, Ben Stokes works this to long on for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal flights this full outside off, Ben Stokes taps this towards cover-point.
Yuzvendra Chahal has changed ends and comes into the attack.
Swing and a miss! Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Joe Root presses forward and leans to drive but he misses.
Driven firmly but a good stop! Pitched up, outside off. Ben Stokes drives this one powerfully, towards cover. Virat Kohli gets right hand down in time and makes a half-stop there! Only a single.
Ben Stokes takes the aerial route now! Not timed as well though! A fuller one, around middle. Ben Stokes heaves it over mid-wicket. Two taken!
A fuller one, around middle and off. Ben Stokes pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around off. Ben Stokes covers the line of the ball, shows the full face of the bat, and defends it out.
Mohammad Shami starts from 'round the wicket on a good length and angles this ball in from outside off. Ben Stokes defends this down the pitch.
Mohammad Shami is back on!
Wide from the stumps from a good length. Ben Stokes guides this to deep cover for a single.
Prasidh Krishna bowling good length and on off. Ben Stokes fends this towards point.
Goes full outside off, Ben Stokes knocks this towards the cover fielder.

FOUR! This has been muscled! Good-length delivery outside off, Ben Stokes charges down the wicket and catches the ball on the full. Punches this through the gap in covers for a wonderful boundary! Ben Stokes is off the mark in style!
On a good length angling away from the left-hander from off, Ben Stokes fends this back to the bowler.
Prasidh Krishna begins with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Joe Root under edges this fine towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Ben Stokes uses the depth of the crease and blocks it towards cover. A successful over from Yuzvendra Chahal comes to an end!
Full, tad quicker, on the pads. Ben Stokes taps it towards mid-wicket.

DRINKS! The players will take a short break. England batters have done much better than they did in their last outing. The Indian bowlers may find themselves unlucky they bowled with fire all morning. England have lost two wickets and now Joe Root and Ben Stokes need to build a partnership to take them to a good score.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Yuzvendra Chahal strikes! A much-needed wicket for India, a rather important one as Jonny Bairstow was just about to get going. They have now got rid of another set batter. A loopy ball, slower through the air, full, this one lands and spins away a tad. Jonny Bairstow gets down on his knee and looks to slog-sweep this but he misses. The ball goes on to hit the stumps. Jonny Bairstow departs after a good start.
Loopy ball, around middle and leg, full again. Joe Root tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Full, tosses it up, around middle. Jonny Bairstow drives it back towards long on.
Fuller ball, around middle. Jonny Bairstow cuts it towards point.
Prasidh Krishna continues to bowl short and wide outside off, Jonny Bairstow guides this to deep point for a single. 11 runs off this over!
FOUR! Jonny Bairstow has his eye in now! Prasidh Krishna serves this one short as well and outside off, Jonny Bairstow pulls this towards mid-wicket for the second boundary of the over!

Good-length delivery outside off. Joe Root hits this straight to the point fielder. Suryakumar Yadav takes a shy at the non-striker's end and gets a direct hit. The ball rolls over towards mid-wicket and the batters get a single.
Prasidh Krishna serves this one short and wide outside off, Jonny Bairstow punches this past the cover fielder for a single.
BAck-of-a-length delivery outside off. Jonny Bairstow slashes this straight to point.
FOUR! Jonny Bairstow is in the mood now! A fraction short outside off, Jonny Bairstow pulls this wide of the deep square leg boundary for four more runs!
Full again, around middle. Jonny Bairstow tucks it towards square leg. A single taken!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full, loopy ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow goes inside out over cover for a boundary.
Outside off, shorter one, spinning away. Jonny Bairstow looks to cut this away but he bails out in the end.
Quicker this time, full, around middle. Jonny Bairstow blocks it out.
Another leg-break, outside off, shorter one. Joe Root cuts it past point for a single.
Outside off, spinning away, shorter ball. Jonny Bairstow cuts it towards point for a single.
Width on offer, a length ball. Joe Root cuts it hard but cannot get it past Ravindra Jadeja at backward point.
Back of a length, outside off. Joe Root cuts it towards third man for a couple of runs.
A length ball, around middle. Joe Root tucks it towards mid-wicket. He wanted a single there but he sent back in time.
Outside off, on a length. Joe Root slashes it towards backward point. Ravindra Jadeja dives and makes a good stop.
Pulls his length back a tad, outside off. Joe Root walks across and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Swinging in, fuller ball, around off. Joe Root lunges forward and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Outside off, on a length, shaping away. Joe Root dabs it past point for a single.
A length ball, angling in, around middle. Joe Root works it away towards mid on.
Fuller one, around middle. Jonny Bairstow taps it towards mid on and runs across to the other end.
Back of a length, around middle. Joe Root pulls it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Another length ball, around middle. Joe Root stays in his crease and tries to block this one but the ball goes off the outside edge and towards point.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow leans to block this but the ball goes off his leading edge towards cover for a single.
Powerplay 2! India can have four fielders at the boundary now.
Quick single! A length ball, angling in, around middle, at 134 clicks. Jonny Bairstow tucks it towards mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. 5 runs off Prasidh Krishna's first over!
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to go over long on this time but he fails to et any connection on that!
Pitches it up now, outside off. Joe Root drives it firmly through cover. The ball will not race away but the batters pick up three runs. Joe Root gets off the mark with that!
On a length, outside off. Joe Root blocks it out.
Fuller this time, around middle. Joe Root flicks and finds the fielder at mid on.
Prasidh Krishna begins with a good-length delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to flick but the ball goes off his outside edge towards third man for a single.
On a length, outside off. Joe Root leaves it alone. End of a successful over from Hardik Pandya!
Joe Root walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! There is the first breakthrough India were looking for! Hardik Pandya strikes and gets rid of Jason Roy! He departs after a positive start. A shorter one, around middle. Jason Roy pulls this one but the ball goes off his top edge and towards deep square leg. Suryakumar Yadav pouches it safely!
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Hardik Pandya

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter one, outside off. Jason Roy pushes it towards cover.
Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Halt in play! The physios are out to give Jonny Bairstow some attention as he looks to be hit hard on his ribs.
This one is angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow tries to flick this but he misses and gets hit near his groin area. He seems in pain there!
Hardik Pandya begins with a length ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow leaves it alone.
Hardik Pandya comes into the attack.
Fuller now, outside off. Jason Roy drives and finds the fielder at cover. A maiden by Jasprit Bumrah!
Back of a length, outside off. Jason Roy taps it towards cover.
Too short on this occasion, around middle. Jason Roy pulls but he misses.
DROPPED! Never easy to take those! Full, on middle, Jason Roy drives it uppishly towards the bowler. Jasprit Bumrah sticks his right hand out but fails to grab this one.
Fuller now, outside off. Jason Roy drives and finds the fielder at cover.
On a length, angling in, down the leg side. Jason Roy shuffles across and tries to flick this one but he misses. The ball flies just past the leg pole.
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Jonny Bairstow looks to flick this but he gets a leading edge away from the fielder at cover.
BEATEN! Lovely ball! On a length, this one nips back in, around middle and off. Jonny Bairstow looks to block this but he gets beaten on the inside edge.

EDGED AND FOUR! Streaky boundary! A length ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow leans to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the first slip fielder towards third man for a boundary. There was a second slip in place before the ball, had he still been there that would have been an easy catch. Rohit Sharma wanted the second slip but Mohammad Shami had asked for it to be removed and now they have deided to place the fielder there.
Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Jason Roy tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Drops it short now, around middle. Jason Roy leaves it alone.
Shorter one, outside off. Jason Roy shows the full face of the bat and knocks it to the fielder at mid off.
Another length delivery, around middle. Jonny Bairstow blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow dabs it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Bang! Fraction short on this occasion, around middle. Jonny Bairstow pulls it powerfully past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, a length delivery. Jonny Bairstow taps it off the back foot towards cover.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Jason Roy tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery, around milddle. Jason Roy blocks it out.
On a length and angled into the stumps, Jason Roy works this through mid-wicket and gets three runs. 13 runs of this over from Mohammad Shami!

SIX! Jason Roy finally gets one from the middle of his bat! On a length, around middle. Jason Roy shimmies down the pitch and dispatches it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie! Jason Roy is getting a move on here!
What a comeback from Mohammad Shami as he serves this on a good length and on middle. Jason Roy plays for the angle and the ball straightens and beats his outside edge! How did he not nick that!

FOUR! Just the luck Jason Roy is looking for to get going! Mohammad Shami goes a little fuller outside off, Jason Roy goes hard at the ball and gets a thick inside edge that flies past the off pole and beats the keeper to his left to run away to the fine leg boundary! This could be the day Jason Roy returns to form!
Right on the money! This one is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Jason Roy fends this back to the bowler!
On a good length and angled into the stumps, Jason Roy shimmies down the wicket and fends the ball towards mid-wicket.
On a good length outside off, Jonny Bairstow defends this solidly towards backward point.

FOUR! This one is all timing! Jasprit Bumrah serves this on a length and angles this into the pads. Jonny Bairstow just swats it off his legs and the ball flies to the sqaure leg boundary for four runs!

Goes closer to the stumps and full, Jonny Bairstow flicks this in the gap between mid-wicket and mid on. Yuzvendra Chahal at mid on dives and a half stop prevents the ball from going to the boundary. A couple of runs for England!
Jasprit Bumrah goes slightly fuller outside off, Jonny Bairstow looks to punch this but gets an inside edge onto his body and the ball rolls down the pitch.
Serves this on a good length as well outside off, Jonny Bairstow gets a good connection this time but finds the point fielder.
On a good length outside off, Jonny Bairstow places this in the gap between point and cover. Not the best timing and gets only a couple of runs.
Swing and a miss! Length again, width on offer. Jason Roy tries to slash this away, but he fails to get any bat on it. Testing over from Mohammad Shami!

Beaten once again! This is lovely bowling from Mohammad Shami! Bounce and movement there for him! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Jason Roy tries to defend this one off the back foot and he misses.
Good-length delivery, swinging away, outside off. Jason Roy leaves it alone this time.
Beaten! Well bowled! This one lands on a length, shapes away, outside off. Jason Roy stays in his crease and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a length this time, around middle and leg, at 140 clicks. Jason Roy flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary. First boundary of the innings!
Pitches it up, around off, at 141 clicks. Jason Roy leans to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat and goes towards mid on.

Jasprit Bumrah serves this one full and angled into the stumps, Jason Roy flicks this through mid-wicket and collects three runs as Yuzvendra Chahal manages to reach it and stop it going for a boundary!
Jasprit Bumrah goes back of a length outside off, Jason Roy gets on top of the delivery and defends with a wobbly bat down into the pitch.

The one also comes in sharply! Jasprit Bumrah goes a fraction fuller outside off, Jason Roy comes down the wicket to play a shot but gets beaten and the ball hits the pads as he goes to the keeper! Big appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Jason Roy having serious trouble with the in-swinging ball!
On a good length outside off, Jason Roy happy to leave this one alone.
Jasprit Bumrah serves this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back in from outside off, Jason Roy gets an inside edge that rolls through to the keeper!
Jasprit Bumrah begins with a back-of-a-length delivery angled in from outside off, Jason Roy stays back and guides it towards square leg.
Jasprit Bumrah will begin from the other end.
Swing and miss this time! Mohammad Shami bowling on a good length outside off, Jonny Bairstow looks to slash at this a misses as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Beaten! On a good length once again outside off, Jonny Bairstow is beaten all ends up by the away movement.
Good-length delivery on middle, Jonny Bairstow defends this back towards the bowler.
This one is on a good length outside off, and gets a bit of extra bounce as Jonny Bairstow gets on top of it and taps it towards covers.
Goes a fraction fuller just outside off, Jason Roy gets it away towards cover-point for a single. He gets off the mark with that!
Serves this on a good length in line with the stumps. Jason Roy fends this back to the bowler.
WIDE! Mohammad Shami begins with wayward delivery going down leg from a good length. The umpire calls this wide.

We are set for action to get underway! The players have made their way out to the middle. Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow will open the batting for England. Mohammad Shami will begin with the ball. Let's go!

Jos Buttler says he would have probably bowled first as well but says that it is usually 50-50 at Lord's and even batting first could be good. Says there is a lot of moisture in the pitch and it is very hot. Admits that it will be initially tricky to bat but once they get in they can set a good total on the board. Says they will go with the same team and on the previous loss says that they got to move on and only take things from the game that we help them learn. He insists that batting is their strength and that will not change with one game. When asked about the World Cup win at the same venue he says that three years have flown by since and it's always thrilling to be back in this stadium.

Rohit Sharma the skipper of India says that they are going to bowl first, not much grass on this wicket but there is some moisture. Adds that it's better to have a score in front of them considering the dimensions of the ground. Informs that Virat Kohli is fit and he comes back in for Shreyas Iyer. On Jasprit Bumrah, he says that he has been a proper bowler across all formats, and it is always nice to have a bowler like him in the squad. On being asked about Rishabh Pant's wicket-keeping skills, he says that he did really well and it was quite challenging for him since the ball tends to keep moving even after passing the stumps. Concludes by saying that Lord's is one of the best stadiums in the world and they are keen to play well here.
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Liam Livingstone, Moeen Ali, David Willey, Craig Overton, Brydon Carse, Reece Topley.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Shikhar Dhawan, Virat Kohli (In for Shreyas Iyer), Suryakumar Yadav, Rishabh Pant (WK), Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Mohammad Shami, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Yuzvendra Chahal.
TOSS - India have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

PITCH REPORT -  Graeme Swann gives us an insight into the pitch. He says that Lord's is a batting pitch usually, a cracking batting wicket. Adds that there is no grass on this wicket and there might be not much bounce as well in this game.

If the pitch is anywhere close to what it was to the one at the Oval, the captain winning the toss will bowl first without a second thought. The weather in London seems only partly cloudy. We can expect no interruptions. Having said that no one can predict the weather in England, but let us hope for the best. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
